name: check_key
description: Check a provider API key with one free call to the provider. Returns ok, the default model and whether it is still available. Makes no billed call.

output.description: JSON object {provider, ok, default_model, default_model_ok, detail}

params.name: provider
params.description: Which vendor's key to check. gemini and openai for now; kling, fal and elevenlabs are added once their connectors gain check_key().
